Create choropleth maps showing median sales prices and numbers of sales 
by census tract

```{r set up}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
library(urbnthemes)
#devtools::install_github("UrbanInstitute/urbnmapr")
library(urbnmapr)
set_urbn_defaults(style = "map")
library(openxlsx)
library(haven)
```

```{r define colors}
#colorschemes
blues <- c("#CFE8F3","#A2D4EC","#73BFE2","#46ABDB","#1696D2","#12719E","#0A4C6A","#062635") 
greys <- c("#f5f5f5", "#D2D2D2","#9D9D9D","#696969","#353535", "#000000")
yellows <- c("#FFF2CF","#FCE39E","#FDD870","#FCCB41","#FDBF11","#E88E2D","#CA5800","#843215") 
pinks <- c("#F5CBDF","#EB99C2","#E46AA7","#E54096","#EC008B","#AF1F6B","#761548","#351123") 
greens <- c("#DCEDD9","#BCDEB4","#98CF90","#78C26D","#55B748","#408941","#2C5C2D","#1A2E19") 
reds <- c("#F8D5D4","#F1AAA9","#E9807D","#E25552","#DB2B27","#A4201D","#6E1614","#370B0A")

rfk_west_color <- "#ec008b"
rfk_east_color <- "#55b748"
metro_sta_color <- "#000000"
rfk_stadium_star_color <- "#fdbf11"
housing_project_color <- "#000000"
```

```{r load data}

#RFK areas
rfk_tracts <- read.csv("//Sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/result/rfk_tracts.csv")

#House sales by tract
sales_tract <- read_sas("//sas1/DCDATA/Libraries/Realprop/Data/sales_sum_tr20.sas7bdat")

```

```{r load shapefiles}
water <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Waterbodies_2023/Waterbodies_2023.shp") %>%
  mutate(water = "Waterways")

national_parks <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/National_Parks/National_Parks.shp") %>%
  mutate(parks = "National Parks")

roads <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Roads/Roads.shp")

tract_shape <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Census_Tracts_in_2020/Census_Tracts_in_2020.shp") |> 
  select(GEOID)

ward_shape <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Ward_-_2022/Ward_-_2022.shp")

#re-attach geometry to RFK tracts
rfk_shape <- tract_shape %>%
  mutate(GEOID=as.numeric(GEOID)) %>%
  select(GEOID) %>%
  left_join(rfk_tracts, by = "GEOID")

#shape file with only RFK area
rfk_only_shape <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(rfk_group == 1)

#shape file with only RFK tract
rfk_only_tract <- rfk_only_shape %>% filter(GEOID == "11001006804")

#confirm CRS of census tract date
st_crs(ward_shape)$epsg

#create sf object with stadium coordinates
stadium_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532), coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

#join sales data to tract sf
sales_tract_sf <- left_join(tract_shape, sales_tract, by = c("GEOID" = "Geo2020"))

#DC Coordinates
dccoords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward_shape)))

dcymin = min(dccoords$Y)
dcymax = max(dccoords$Y)
dcxmin = min(dccoords$X)
dcxmax = max(dccoords$X)

#for outlines of the RFK areas
west_outline <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1)

east_outline <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1)



```
```{r quantiles}
quantile(sales_tract_sf$r_mprice_sf_2025, probs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r create map}

# 1. Pre-bin continuous data and explicitly name NA values safely
sales_tract_sf_binned <- sales_tract_sf %>%
  mutate(
    # Create the initial 5 bins
    price_bin = cut(
      r_mprice_sf_2025,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 500000, 775000, 1000000, 1500000, Inf),
      labels = c("Under $500,000", "$500,000 - 775,000", "$775,000 - 1,000,000", "$1,000,000 - 1,500,000", "Over $1,500,000"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    # Safely convert NA values into an explicit 6th category level
    price_bin = fct_na_value_to_level(price_bin, level = "Data Unavailable")
  )

# 2. Map the custom NA color inside scale_fill_manual
sales_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sales_tract_sf_binned, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = price_bin), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Median sales price, 2025 ($ 2025)",
    values = c(
      "Under $500,000"         = "#CFE8F3",
      "$500,000 - 775,000"     = "#73BFE2",
      "$775,000 - 1,000,000"   = "#1696D2",
      "$1,000,000 - 1,500,000" = "#0a4c6a",
      "Over $1,500,000"        = "#000000",
      "Data Unavailable"       = "#D2D2D2"
    ),
    drop = FALSE 
  ) + 
  theme_void() + 
  # Display a star at stadium coordinates
  geom_sf(data = stadium_sf, aes(geometry = geometry, color = "RFK Stadium"), shape = "\u2605", size = 5) +
  geom_sf(data = west_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA, size = 0.75) +
  geom_sf(data = east_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA, size = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
      "RFK West" = rfk_west_color,
      "RFK Stadium" = rfk_stadium_star_color
    ),
    limits = c("RFK East", "RFK West", "RFK Stadium"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1), # Changed back to guide_legend since the data is now discrete
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.text = element_text(vjust = 0.5) # Force vertical text center alignment
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(dcxmin, dcxmax),
    ylim = c(dcymin, dcymax),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  annotation_scale(unit_category = "imperial")

sales_map

```
